lines.text: It hosts a server. infra is down while mac-mini restarts, about 2 min.
linux-3, review-bot stop and keep their disk. Servers keep running.
Its VMs keep running; station stops showing it. You can add it again.
infra is unreachable for about a minute while it boots. Its health checks run again after the boot.
infra stays stopped until you start it.
This can't be undone. It goes with its disk (80 GB), its address and 2 ports.
